newsitem.title: ISRAEL: London IPO by Israel's Plasson still open.
newsitem.headline: London IPO by Israel's Plasson still open.

text.p: Plasson Plastic Products' initial public offering on the London Stock Exchange has been extended to Tuesday evening, a source close to the offering said on Monday.
"The offer remains open. It has been extended as a result of serious expressions of interest that we need time to explore," the source said.

Plasson's 20 million pound ($31 million) IPO commenced last week but has encountered problems, reportedly due to market concerns over the future of Middle East peace raised in the wake of recent clashes between Israelis and Palestinians.
Plasson managing director Shaul Ashkenazi said on Sunday that it was likely the shares would sell closer to 1.5 pounds each, down from the 1.55-1.60 range originally sought.
The offering of the kibbutz-owned company and the first Israeli concern to seek an LSE listing is being sponsored by Societe Generale Strauss Turnbull.
